title: JetBrains IDE settings
whyItMatters: JetBrains IDEs keep per-project settings, recent project names and plugin state here. Saved passwords are not in this folder, but the project history still shows what the person worked on.
source: JetBrains, Directories used by the IDE: configuration is stored in ~/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/<product><version> - https://www.jetbrains.com/help/idea/directories-used-by-the-ide-to-store-settings-caches-plugins-and-logs.html
notes: Database and VCS passwords are kept in the macOS Keychain, not in this folder; the credentials.keychains rule covers that store. Caches and logs live under ~/Library/Caches and ~/Library/Logs instead.

cleanup.exportFirst: Use File > Export Settings in each JetBrains IDE to save the settings you want to keep.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of JetBrains Account in the IDE, and remove this Mac from the account's authorized devices on the JetBrains website.
steps: Sign out of the JetBrains Account in each IDE.
Uninstall the IDEs by moving them to the Trash.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes per-project settings, recent project names and plugin state for every JetBrains IDE on this Mac. Project files themselves are not touched.
cleanup.source: JetBrains, Directories used by the IDE to store settings, caches, plugins and logs: https://www.jetbrains.com/help/idea/directories-used-by-the-ide-to-store-settings-caches-plugins-and-logs.html
